optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Pipeline Engineer, Developer Tools Platform
professionalSummary: Maintains build-event ingestion pipelines and their schemas, ensuring backward compatibility with older event formats.
Maintains daily aggregate jobs that consolidate build, test, and deployment events for engineering dashboards.
Reduced daily aggregate completion time from 3 h 40 m to 1 h 10 m, measured against the published baseline.
Coordinates schema and job changes with dashboard and platform teams, documenting responsibilities.
Writes lineage notes detailing source topics, incremental logic, known limitations, and hand‑over items.
experienceHighlights: Maintained Kafka consumer pipelines writing to the events warehouse and added schema versioning to support older event formats.
Maintained daily aggregate jobs that roll events into per‑repository tables behind engineering dashboards.
Reduced daily aggregate completion time from 3 h 40 m to 1 h 10 m after incremental rewrite, measured over thirty days against the baseline.
Coordinated schema and job changes with dashboard and platform teams in weekly data syncs, with approvals from platform lead and table contract confirmation from dashboard team.
Authored lineage notes for aggregate jobs, listing source topics, incremental logic, limitation that late events beyond 48 h were not re‑aggregated, and hand‑over items for on‑call.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Pipeline monitoring dashboard export showing daily completion time for sixty days, baseline line, and release marker; includes job run identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents the candidate’s maintenance of build‑event ingestion pipelines, daily aggregate jobs, reduction in completion time, coordination with dashboard and platform teams, and documentation of lineage and limitations. No claims about leadership, production deployment status, or metrics beyond those explicitly stated are made.

role.roleTitle: Data Pipeline Engineer, Developer Tools Platform

evidence.text: Maintained the build-event ingestion pipelines (Kafka consumers writing to the events warehouse) and their schemas, adding schema versioning so that older event formats kept loading after producer changes.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of maintenance and schema versioning.

evidence.text: Maintained the daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into the per-repository tables behind the engineering dashboards.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of maintenance of daily aggregate jobs.

evidence.text: The daily aggregate's completion time dropped from 3 hours 40 minutes to 1 hour 10 minutes after the incremental rewrite was released, measured over the following thirty days in the pipeline monitoring dashboard against the published baseline of 3 hours 40 minutes.
evidence.notes: Direct measurement of completion time reduction.

evidence.text: Coordinated schema and job changes with the dashboard team and the platform team in the weekly data sync; the platform lead approved warehouse changes and the dashboard team confirmed the table contracts.

Wrote the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, listing source topics, the incremental logic, the known limitation that late events beyond 48 hours were not re-aggregated, and the hand-over items for on-call.
evidence.notes: Direct documentation of lineage, limitation, and hand-over.
